name: Packet Scheduling and Operating-Region Evaluation
purpose: Measure the realized packet-level value of prediction under identical traffic and physical link conditions.
acceptance_criteria: all policies use identical exogenous traces within each paired comparison
physical delivery is scored only from ground truth
deadline semantics are explicit and deterministic
raw scenario results retain scheduler identity and operating-condition identifiers
publication status remains PARTIAL until frozen Stage-05/PHY artifacts and the complete declared grid are executed
forbidden: using predictions as realized channel capacity
comparing policies on different random traces
promoting synthetic smoke tests to publication evidence
